AirQualityObserved

One air-quality station in the city and the latest hourly means it reported.

  • dataProvider (Property): Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.
  • dateObserved (Property): The end of the latest hour a reading of the entity covers.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.
  • name (LanguageProperty): The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • pm10 (Property), unit ug/m3: Particulate matter up to 10 µm, the hour's mean at the station.
  • pm25 (Property), unit ug/m3: Particulate matter up to 2.5 µm, the hour's mean at the station.
  • source (Property): The open-data service the entity was read from.
  • stationCode (Property): The station's EoI code in the European air-quality network, such as `SK0263A`.

Event

  • endDate (Property): The day the event ends, in the city's local calendar.
  • endTime (Property): The time the event ends, local time in Banská Bystrica (Europe/Bratislava), `HH:MM`.
  • eventCategory (Property): The kind of event, from the city's own categories.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.
  • name (LanguageProperty): The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • source (Property): The open-data service the entity was read from.
  • startDate (Property): The day the event starts, in the city's local calendar.
  • startTime (Property): The time the event starts, local time in Banská Bystrica (Europe/Bratislava), `HH:MM`.

School

  • annualBudget (Property): The school's budget for `budgetYear`, in euro.
  • budgetYear (Property): The year `annualBudget` is for, as the school map's column names it.
  • dataProvider (Property): Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

  • nonTeachingStaff (Property): Non-teaching staff, in full-time equivalents.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • pupilCount (Property): How many pupils or children the school or facility has, a count and never a name.
  • schoolCode (Property): The school's EDUID in the national register of schools and school facilities.

AdministrativeArea

One district (okres) or municipality (obec) of the region, its outline and its code.

  • areaCode (Property): The area's statistical code: LAU 1 (`SK0321`) for a district, LAU 2 (`SK0321508438`) for a municipality, the same codes the Statistical Office's cubes carry in `refArea`.

  • divisionLevel (Property): Which tier of the territorial division the area is.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.
  • name (LanguageProperty): The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • refParentArea (Relationship): The district a municipality lies in; absent on a district.
  • source (Property): The open-data service the entity was read from.
  • surfaceArea (Property), unit m2: The area's surface as the cadastre states it.

Bridge

One bridge of the road network in the region, its road, its age, its size and who manages it.

  • bridgeCode (Property): The bridge's number in the national road databank (Cestná databanka), such as `M9673`.

  • districtName (Property): The district the record lies in, by name, as the publisher writes it.
  • heritageStatus (Property): Whether the bridge is a listed monument; absent where the databank does not say.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.
  • managerName (Property): The road administration that manages the bridge.
  • name (LanguageProperty): The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • roadClass (Property): The class of the road the bridge carries.
  • roadNumber (Property): The number of the road the bridge carries, such as `66b`.
  • source (Property): The open-data service the entity was read from.
  • spanCount (Property): How many openings the bridge has.
  • structureKind (Property): The kind of load-bearing structure, in the databank's words, such as `dosková`.
  • structureMaterial (Property): The material of the load-bearing structure, in the databank's words.
  • yearBuilt (Property): The year the bridge was built.

  • calculationPeriod (Property): The window the value actually covers, as `{ start, end }` RFC 3339 instants. It is the window the pipeline used and not the one it was asked for, so the distance between `calculationPeriod.end` and `updatedAt` is how stale the source is.
  • computedBy (Relationship): The Pipeline that computed it, as its URN.
  • currentValue (Property): The number, with its unit on the Property as `unitCode`, a UN/CEFACT common code, and the instant it describes as `observedAt`. A window with no reading in it carries the string `not measured` instead of a number, and never a zero: a zero reads as a measurement (Development/10 §5).
  • derivedFrom (Relationship): The Endpoint the sources were read through, as its URN. The endpoint and not the space: what an indicator could see is what that endpoint's policy let it see.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.
  • name (Property): The indicator's own name, equal to the `{localId}` of its id, so the territory is legible without parsing the URN.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • updatedAt (Property): When the pipeline last ran, as an NGSI-LD DateTime. It is the run and not the window: an indicator whose source stopped moving keeps its window and gains a newer `updatedAt`, which is the visible fact that the source is static.

The one attribute of this model no pipeline writes and no pipeline overwrites, so an application may offer it for editing without the next run silently taking the words back (AP-62, EP-14). KeyPerformanceIndicator

One computed indicator, registered from the helsinki-kpi space.

  • calculationFormula (Property): How the value was computed, in words a reader can check the number against: the measure, the aggregation, the window and any divisor, such as `per km² of the district's own area`.
  • calculationPeriod (Property): The window the value actually covers, as `{ start, end }` RFC 3339 instants. It is the window the pipeline used and not the one it was asked for, so the distance between `calculationPeriod.end` and `updatedAt` is how stale the source is.
  • computedBy (Relationship): The Pipeline that computed it, as its URN.
  • currentValue (Property): The number, with its unit on the Property as `unitCode`, a UN/CEFACT common code, and the instant it describes as `observedAt`. A window with no reading in it carries the string `not measured` instead of a number, and never a zero: a zero reads as a measurement (Development/10 §5).
  • derivedFrom (Relationship): The Endpoint the sources were read through, as its URN. The endpoint and not the space: what an indicator could see is what that endpoint's policy let it see.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.
  • name (Property): The indicator's own name, equal to the `{localId}` of its id, so the territory is legible without parsing the URN.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • updatedAt (Property): When the pipeline last ran, as an NGSI-LD DateTime. It is the run and not the window: an indicator whose source stopped moving keeps its window and gains a newer `updatedAt`, which is the visible fact that the source is static.

KeyPerformanceIndicator

One number for one window, with the provenance that makes it auditable.

  • calculationFormula (Property): How the value was computed, in words a reader can check the number against: the measure, the aggregation, the window and any divisor, such as `per km² of the district's own area`.
  • calculationPeriod (Property): The window the value actually covers, as `{ start, end }` RFC 3339 instants. It is the window the pipeline used and not the one it was asked for, so the distance between `calculationPeriod.end` and `updatedAt` is how stale the source is.
  • computedBy (Relationship): The Pipeline that computed it, as its URN.
  • currentValue (Property): The number, with its unit on the Property as `unitCode`, a UN/CEFACT common code, and the instant it describes as `observedAt`. A window with no reading in it carries the string `not measured` instead of a number, and never a zero: a zero reads as a measurement (Development/10 §5).
  • derivedFrom (Relationship): The Endpoint the sources were read through, as its URN. The endpoint and not the space: what an indicator could see is what that endpoint's policy let it see.
  • location (GeoProperty): Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.
  • name (Property): The indicator's own name, equal to the `{localId}` of its id, so the territory is legible without parsing the URN.
  • observedAt (Property): When the observation the entity reports was made.
  • updatedAt (Property): When the pipeline last ran, as an NGSI-LD DateTime. It is the run and not the window: an indicator whose source stopped moving keeps its window and gains a newer `updatedAt`, which is the visible fact that the source is static.
